# Rightium

> Rightium provides patent research, IP intelligence, licensing research and chemical safety intelligence services from Bengaluru, India.

This file is a guide to public website content. Service scope, fees and timelines are agreed for each engagement. Patent research supports review by the responsible legal or business team.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.rightium.org/): Overview of Rightium.
- [Services](https://www.rightium.org/services): Service catalogue.
- [About](https://www.rightium.org/about): Company information.
- [Contact](https://www.rightium.org/contact): Discuss scope and request a proposal.

## Services

- [Patent search services](https://www.rightium.org/services/search-solutions): Patentability, novelty, invalidity, freedom to operate, patent watch and state of the art searches.
- [Patent landscaping and competitive intelligence](https://www.rightium.org/services/intelligence-solutions): Landscape analysis, competitor research and technology scouting.
- [Patent database strategy](https://www.rightium.org/services/patent-database-strategy): Database evaluation and migration.
- [Patent drafting and prosecution support](https://www.rightium.org/services/prep-and-prosecution): Drafting, prosecution, paralegal and docketing support.
- [Patent licensing research](https://www.rightium.org/services/licensing): Portfolio mining, evidence of use claim charts and directed prosecution research.
- [Chemical safety intelligence](https://www.rightium.org/services/chemical-safety-intelligence): Toxicology data, literature searches and safety reports.
- [IP consulting and audit](https://www.rightium.org/services/ip-consulting-and-audit): Strategy, process and asset audits.

## Optional

- [Insights](https://www.rightium.org/blog): Published articles.
- [Privacy](https://www.rightium.org/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://www.rightium.org/terms): Terms of use.
